basis: The chart shows May's bar is drastically shorter than all other months (just above the 10,000 tick), while the next lowest month (Jun) is near 17,500. This extreme relative isolation compared to the rest of the series (ranging from ~17,500 to 40,000) constitutes a significant anomaly. In operational monitoring contexts, such a severe deviation from the normal range typically warrants escalation to a critical review rather than standard follow-up, even without a strict numerical threshold, as it represents an outlier condition.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review
